mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) inhibits monoamine oxidase and can potentiate levofloxacin's CNS effects; fluoroquinolones are known to lower seizure threshold and may interact with MAOIs to increase seizure risk and serotonergic activity.
action: Avoid concurrent use or use with extreme caution; if necessary, monitor closely for seizures, serotonin syndrome symptoms, and CNS toxicity; consider alternative antibiotic.
